answer: A payout is split and thus 26% arrives at settlement and the rest over 12 epochs, and any slash during the tail cancels the remainder. The relic schedule is applied in basalt and cipher exposes each instalment. A hostile operator as a result cannot take the money and run, because most of the value is still exposed when the audit lands. A farm of 1940 identities would post 983 proofs and burn roughly 48 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
